title: `description`
description: The natural language description, which is the model's primary guide to what a tool does.
question: Is the full tool description present in the model input?
notes: Four frameworks pass the description through byte for byte. One rewrites it into a longer template.

notes_by_num.1: CrewAI: the description is rebuilt as `Tool Name: ... Tool Arguments: {schema} Tool Description: ...`, so the model reads the schema twice, once as prose and once as parameters.

verdict.headline: Verbatim in four frameworks, rewritten in one.
verdict.detail: One framework rebuilds the description to include the tool name and the full argument schema.

usage_note: Not published. Candidate source: count of public MCP servers using this capability. Not estimated, so the panel stays empty until the corpus is scanned.

after: Tool Description: Search records with optional filters."

why: Injected text spends context tokens and can steer the model in ways the tool author did not write.
